title: Outdoor EV Charger Installation: Mounting, Conduit Routing, and Wiring (This Old House)

locations.name: Exterior wall on far side of driveway (outdoor EV charger installation)
locations.basis: Transcript references mounting on an exterior wall near the driveway and parking area; mentions outdoor installation

summary: This This Old House segment documents a residential outdoor Level 2 EV charger installation at a house with no garage, positioned on the exterior wall at the far side of the driveway. The crew explains driving levels of charging (Level 1 through Level 3) and selects Level 2 for overnight charging, noting 8 hours can restore ~150–200 miles. They trench and trench-fill a conduit from under the driveway up to the house, pull wires through, install end fittings, glue and seat the conduit, and then make the three power connections inside the charger. The installation is described as weatherproof, outdoor-rated, and approved after consulting a local electrical inspector to ensure compliance with local and national codes. The video emphasizes practical placement to minimize cord length, outdoor equipment suitability, and considerations for future EV readiness.
